appropriate_uses: Congressional research summaries, defense budget context, procurement-line descriptions, authorization and appropriations baselines, and source leads to official budget documents.
inappropriate_uses: Treating congressional research summaries as real-time inventory counts, operational availability proof, or independent confirmation of classified stockpile levels.
known_failure_modes: Congressional framing; lag; dependence on agency submissions and public budget justifications; summaries may omit classified or operational detail.
name: Congressional Research Service
observables: defense budget summaries, procurement context, legislative research, program baselines
originating_chain_rule: CRS products based on the same agency budget submission, authorization act, or appropriations action remain linked to that underlying public-document chain.

review_history.note: Added for FY2027 defense-budget and interceptor-procurement verification context.
